All — final readiness update and go/no-go checklist for the planned 2027-07-14 cutover. Summary and owners below.

Go criteria (all must be green):
- Load test pass (owner: devops@cardiohealth.com)
- Smoke-test gating passes 3 consecutive runs (owner: rishi_malhotra)
- DocuSign signed and PO/finance confirmed (owner: ben_carter)
- Observability dashboard up + on-call overlap confirmed (owner: laura_bennett)
- Firewall and networking exceptions in place (owner: maria.alvarez@cardiohealth.com)

Fallback/rollback triggers:
- Any production error rate > 2% sustained for 5 minutes post-cutover
- Critical data mismatch on acceptance checks
- Repeated health-check failures (3 consecutive failures)

Rollback path (short):
- Immediately route traffic back to warm cluster (automated fallback)
- Trigger DB maintenance flag and run reverse migration script (CardioHealth will run the flag; Redwood executes reverse script)
- Postmortem and action items within 24 hours

Final logistics: dry run scheduled Wed 07/14 00:30 PT (30 minutes) — Rishi to run smoke tests; CardioHealth DevOps to observe. Go/No-go decision scheduled ~01:45 PT (prior to routing change at 02:00 PT).

I'll keep the acceptance checklist updated (final-acceptance-checklist.xlsx) and will post the DocuSign status link to the HubSpot deal. If all green, consider this our final signoff thread.

Thanks —
